title: MUSCLE MANGA - Kaoru Hanayama's Physique in Grappler Baki (part. 2)
summary: Second part of NH's look at Hanayama in Grappler Baki: his friendship and rivalry with Baki, his bigger physique at the Maximum Tournament, and his doctrine of pure strength over technique, including his refusal to train. NH can't relate to that refusal but admires his honour code of the 'standing man'.
claims: Baki overtook Hanayama because training made the difference despite Hanayama's gifts
A constantly evolving rival is a blessing that keeps you from complacency
Hanayama got bigger in four years without training once, showing near-limitless genetic potential
Hanayama sees training as an admission of weakness; NH can't relate but admires a man willing to die by his principles
Katsumi and Baki's hard work was enough to counter Hanayama's raw genetic strength
One-arm front-raising a 245 lb man would need absurd arm and shoulder strength
Honour, bravery and endurance above all are chivalrous values missing from the modern world
